text:
hannah: Noticed unusual boot failures in eu-west-3 after yesterday's keystore endpoint migration. GPU nodes hit keystore decrypt errors and fail init.
ivan: Confirmed. ~18% of node boots timeout waiting for keystore decrypt. kubelet eventually drains.
jo: Redacted log snippet:
```
ERROR keystore: decrypt failed: AccessDenied: PrincipalNotInEncryptionContext
at keystore/bootstrap.go:87
```
hannah: We moved shared-keystore-shard-3 to a new privatelink endpoint and applied a restrictive endpoint policy during the cutover.
security: The endpoint policy was scoped to require `aws:SourceVpc` and `kms:EncryptionContext:Environment=prod`. It was meant to tighten access but maybe nodes in eu-west-3 are missing that encrypt context during bootstrap.
sre-oncall: Packet traces show the TLS session to keystore proxy completes, but KMS returns AccessDenied for Decrypt call. So connection isn't the issue.
ivan: Quick repro: spin a test node with same bootstrap flow using the same role -> KMS denies unless we inject EncryptionContext key. Our bootstrap agent currently doesn't set Environment tag on the KMS call.
jo: Who pushed the endpoint policy? I see a PR from security-team last night: https://git.internal/privatelink/policies PR#1023.
security: That was me. Intent was to prevent dev VPCs from hitting prod keystore. I didn't realize bootstrap flow doesn't set that EncryptionContext. My bad.
hannah: Impact: region pool at 62% desired, autoscaler is inflating other regions -> extra prewarm + egress. Finance: estimate ~1.8k/hr if this persists.
ivan: Short-term fix options: 1) relax endpoint policy to allow role/edge-bootstrap principal; 2) patch bootstrap agent to include EncryptionContext and roll quickly; 3) create an IAM condition exception for the bootstrap role to allow kms:Decrypt without EncryptionContext.
sre-oncall: Prefer least blast: revert endpoint policy to previous version for eu-west-3 only, then coordinate a proper rollout of the bootstrap client fix.
security: I can revert the policy in 5m for that endpoint. I'll also add an explicit allow for `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/edge-bootstrap` with a short TTL so we can stabilize.
deploy-bot: scheduled policy revert for privatelink endpoint `pl-0a1b2c3d` in eu-west-3 at 12:05 UTC. Will run and report.
jo: After revert, run 100 canary boots: `for i in {1..100}; do curl -sS https://orchestrator/simulate-boot -d '{"region":"eu-west-3"}'; done` and watch keystore logs.
ivan: Also note: the bootstrap agent is on v1.6.2 and the KMS SDK behavior changed in v1.6.3 to auto-attach EncryptionContext for session tokens. But we haven't upgraded nodes yet. So the client fix will need a coordinated rollout.
hannah: Agreed. Revert->monitor->client-roll. I'll update the incident page and ping PG/finance.
security: Revert complete. Endpoint policy restored to previous state at 12:07 UTC.
sre-oncall: Metrics: node ready % recovered from 62% -> 95% in ~6min. No further keystore denies observed in canary.
ivan: We'll schedule the bootstrap agent change for the next patch window and include an automated integration test that asserts KMS calls include EncryptionContext.
hannah: Thanks. Adding a follow-up: add a policy gating step to policy generator to detect keystore-dependent flows and require an explicit rollout flag.
jo: Packet captures and logs uploaded: s3://redwood-debug/eu-west-3/3419999998-keystore-migration.pcap
sre-oncall: Closing thread but will keep monitoring for 1hr. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
